text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Man, oh man.
I just can't stop yawning.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was engrossed in a cookbook last night,
and out of nowhere, an intense wave of sleepiness hit me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I told myself, ‘If I fall asleep, I lose!’ and went toe-to-toe with the sandman."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously I won in the end!
I held out until morning. That drowsiness looked
so pathetic! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Hishi Amazon
ended up staying up late.
